A closer look

Explore the experiences.

A few favorites to help you find your starting point. Images below show our Framingham spa.

Both locations

Infrared sauna

Gentle infrared warmth for a slower moment in your day.

Benefits & considerations

Warmth, less tension & a slower mind. Clearlight infrared warmth offers a place to leave the day behind. People choose sauna time to unwind, soften the feeling of everyday tension, and settle into a calmer evening.

Make it your moment. A quiet break after work, some time to yourself, or part of a regular wind-down ritual. Let the warmth set a slower pace.

Framingham

Salt chamber

A quiet salt-lined setting for time away from the everyday.

Framingham session: 45 minutes

Benefits & considerations

Respiratory comfort & room to exhale. SALT Chamber’s dry salt therapy centers on fine salt particles in a restful environment. People explore it with breathing comfort and respiratory wellness in mind, while enjoying a peaceful escape from everyday dust, noise, and busyness.

Make it your moment. Settle in, let your shoulders drop, and enjoy the salt-air atmosphere. A quiet moment for yourself is reason enough to visit.

Both locations

Normatec compression

Rhythmic air compression around your legs while you recline.

Framingham session: 45 minutes

Benefits & considerations

Lighter-feeling legs & everyday comfort. Normatec’s rhythmic air compression encourages circulation and offers a soothing squeeze-and-release massage. People reach for it after hours at a desk, a long drive, travel, or a day on their feet.

Make it your moment. Recline and let your legs have a break. In Framingham, add guided meditation for a little mental downtime, too.

Before you arrive

Make your visit simple.

Can I walk in?

In Framingham, reservations are highly encouraged; walk-ins are accommodated subject to availability. In Westwood, PEX clients can walk in during flex hours. Private sessions are open to everyone and require a reservation.

Are the services the same at both locations?

Both offer infrared sauna, cold plunge, and Normatec compression. Framingham also offers steam, warm-water hydrotherapy, salt chamber, BioCharger, BrainTap meditation, PEMF, and Flowpresso. Westwood also offers red light therapy.

Can I arrange a private event?

Yes. Framingham can be booked for private events. Email hello@modernwellspa.com to plan your event. For a private Westwood session, book online.
